'''Bolts''' was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of [[Blue Five (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Five's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. During the [[Ambush on Ral's Run]], Blue Five ordered the droid to redistribute power.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
